## 🌳 CleanTree v1.2.0

CleanTree v1.2.0 adds class/spec-aware Damage browsing, an adaptive Damage First Shopping List, a much more useful Cart Purchase Summary, and native support for the EbonAPI 2.1 public contract.

### ⚔️ Class/spec-aware Damage

- **Damage → Recommended** now detects the current class and active WoW 3.3.5 talent spec.
- Spell-oriented characters default to **General + Spell** Damage.
- Physical-oriented characters default to **General + Physical** Damage.
- Hybrid classes follow their active talent tab; ambiguous allocations conservatively fall back to **All Damage**.
- Manual **Recommended**, **All**, **Physical**, and **Spell** views remain available.
- Classification comes from the validated live Rising Carnage prerequisite graph. If that graph no longer matches the expected structure, CleanTree fails open to All Damage instead of guessing.

### 📝 Adaptive Damage First

- The built-in **Damage First** profile now adapts to the current class/spec.
- Real prerequisites always come first.
- General + relevant Damage is prioritized early.
- Survival and Convenience remain part of the full-tree plan.
- The off-spec Damage leg is moved later rather than silently removed.
- Existing manually modified, custom, and imported Shopping Lists remain static and are not rewritten.
- The existing `CTSL1` import/export format is unchanged.

### 🛒 Cart Purchase Summary

- Selecting **Cart** now expands the right panel into **PURCHASE SUMMARY**.
- Compatible staged stat gains are normalized and summed across the exact ranks currently staged.
- Flat values, percentages, and ratings remain separate.
- Conditional, proc, immunity, and other non-additive effects remain visible under **Other Effects** rather than being falsely summed.
- Native staged changes that CleanTree did not stage and cannot identify precisely are explicitly excluded from benefit totals.

### 🔌 EbonAPI 2.1

- CleanTree now requires **EbonAPI 2.1.0+**.
- The bridge requests the public 2.1 API contract.
- Readiness/version reporting uses the authoritative EbonAPI addon handle.
- CleanTree no longer depends on the internal `EbonAPI.Lib` color helper.

### 🧪 Diagnostics

Adds:

- `/cleantree damageprobe`
- `/cleantree cartprobe`
- expanded `/cleantree shoppingprobe`
- expanded `/cleantree apiprobe`

### ✅ Tested

v1.2.0 was validated in-game on Project Ebonhold before release, including:

- EbonAPI 2.1.0 readiness and Talent Database access
- class/spec-aware Damage filtering
- Cart Purchase Summary aggregation
- staging/removal behavior
- native Apply Changes
- Restore Native Skill Tree / Restore CleanTree UI

Purchasing, Apply, cart removal, Endless staging, Buyable Now, CTSL1 import/export, and the established CleanTree layout remain on the known-good paths.

### Requirements

- World of Warcraft 3.3.5a on Project Ebonhold
- [EbonAPI 2.1.0+](https://github.com/Siphelis/EbonAPI/releases/latest) installed separately
